title.narrative: Contribution to the International Union for Conservation of Nature (IUCN) 2020-2024

description.narrative:
The Danish engagement with IUCN has the overarching purpose of supporting IUCN’s Programme 2021-24 in realising its call to action by all IUCN’s Members, scientific network and Secretariat to mobilise collectively on delivering a clear and demonstrable contribution to the SDGs, the post-2020 global biodiversity framework and the Paris Agreement in developing countries.
Following this purpose, the objective of the development cooperation is support to IUCN’s global thematic and regional programmes to achieve their intended results for people, land, water, oceans, and climate, especially on climate adaptation, improved access to water resources, gender equality, and rights and inclusion of indigenous peoples

tag.narrative: By 2020, ensure the conservation, restoration and sustainable use of terrestrial and inland freshwater ecosystems and their services, in particular forests, wetlands, mountains and drylands, in line with obligations under international agreements
By 2020, integrate ecosystem and biodiversity values into national and local planning, development processes, poverty reduction strategies and accounts
Mobilize and significantly increase financial resources from all sources to conserve and sustainably use biodiversity and ecosystems
Promote fair and equitable sharing of the benefits arising from the utilization of genetic resources and promote appropriate access to such resources, as internationally agreed
Take urgent and significant action to reduce the degradation of natural habitats, halt the loss of biodiversity and, by 2020, protect and prevent the extinction of threatened species
